items.title: The transitivity distinguished triangle of naive cotangent complexes for a complete intersection morphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)

items.difficulty_reason: For a factorization X -> Y -> Z with X -> Y a complete intersection morphism, the lemma produces the canonical distinguished triangle f^*NL_{Y/Z} -> NL_{X/Z} -> NL_{X/Y} -> f^*NL_{Y/Z}[1] in D(O_X) recovering the six-term exact sequence. The proof is a written two-step reduction: it identifies the triangle with the vanishing of a canonical map, reduces via the six-term sequence to injectivity on H^{-1} of a specific map, and then verifies that injectivity affine locally by translating through the affine NL lemma and citing the algebra transitivity result for lci morphisms. Retained author proof at lines 3945-3958.
